description: Generate text from a prompt using a language-model provider. Provider-independent: any adapter that satisfies this contract may serve it.

prompt.description: The instruction or question for the model.

max_tokens.description: Optional soft cap on output length; adapters map it to the provider's own flag when supported.

provider_id.description: Which adapter produced the output, e.g. claude-code, codex, ollama.

model_id.description: Provider-reported model identifier, when the CLI exposes it.
